issues.description: The solution's assembleBookstore function has a return type of String but both the problem specification and the template expect it to return a Bookstore. This mismatch will cause a compilation error at the call site (Client.main calls assembleBookstore and expects a Bookstore) and confuses students about the intended return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the return type of assembleBookstore in the solution to -> Bookstore so it matches the problem statement and the template's intended signature, and ensure the function returns the constructed Bookstore (e.g. 'private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore { ... return Bookstore(books: books) }').
